audit_items.proof_trace: The strict ordering is enforced by construction: each timestamp is derived by adding a validated positive period to the prior timestamp (prefundStartTime=block.timestamp, then each successor = predecessor + periodSeconds). Both _verifyValidParams (L176-177) and _verifyValidInitParams (L798) reject any period < 1 hour, guaranteeing every delta is > 0 and thus every inequality is strict. No post-init mutation path exists for any of these timing fields.
